description.value: Tacos Del Norte is an authentic Mexican taqueria located just off Main Street in downtown Penticton, making it a convenient stop for cyclists passing through the Okanagan. The shop is known for homemade corn tortillas, slow-roasted meats like carnitas and pollo, and salsas made fresh daily from scratch. Outdoor seating and a casual, festive atmosphere make it a local favourite for both visitors and residents.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (14 spaces) at 89m; rack at 90m. Total: 14 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully functional and confirms the business is a real, open Mexican taqueria at 85 Backstreet Blvd, Penticton. A dedicated take-out page with online ordering and phone pickup confirms takeout service. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site; these are marked null per the rules.
concerns: OSM record has no address or phone; both were sourced from the website (85 Backstreet Blvd, Penticton, BC V2A 1H7; +1 (778) 476-2288). OSM should be updated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible restaurant confirmed by an active website with full menu, address, and contact details. A natural stop for touring cyclists in downtown Penticton.

wow_evidence: homemade corn tortillas, slow-roasted meats… salsas made fresh daily from scratch
